runEnd.interrupted: Your last run was cut off by a page reload and was not counted.
runEnd.abandonedSub: The run was cut short — what you earned still counts.
runEnd.tip.time: How long you survived on the run clock.
runEnd.tip.level: The highest hero level you reached.
runEnd.tip.elites: Elite enemies slain — they pay extra talent XP.
runEnd.tip.bosses: Bosses slain this run. Each one can drop gear for your class.
runEnd.tip.damage: All damage dealt by your skills.
runEnd.tip.yeop: Yeop picked up during the run, including what you spent on chests.
runEnd.tip.score: Leaderboard score: kills, elites, bosses, Metins, level, Yeop and victory, scaled by difficulty.
runEnd.tip.bankYeop: Yeop you still held when the run ended — added to your treasury.
runEnd.tip.bankShards: Metin shards earned (plus those from duplicate gear). The Blacksmith uses them.
runEnd.xpMult.zoneTip: Later zones multiply the talent XP of a run.
runEnd.noDropsHint: Defeat bosses to find gear for your class.
runEnd.skipHint: Click anywhere to skip the tally
runEnd.noResult: There are no run results to show.
runEnd.skipHintTap: Tap anywhere to skip the tally
